First, please know that grieving the loss of your independence does not make you a bad person, nor does it mean you don't love your baby. Becoming a mother is a massive life transition. Many new moms struggle silently with these exact feelings of losing their identity, even when it seems like everyone else is perfectly happy. What you are experiencing is a very common and valid part of the postpartum period, not just "complaining."

Since your husband is supportive, consider sharing these feelings with him so he can help you carve out time just for yourself. It is also incredibly helpful to mention this to your doctor or a mental health professional. Postpartum emotions can be overwhelming, and a professional can offer support to help you navigate this huge transition, ease that heavy guilt, and help you rediscover the parts of yourself you feel you have lost.
